verdict.rationale: Bento keeps skills and rules in your own repo as model-agnostic Markdown and YAML. Instrumentation is standard OpenTelemetry, so traces can also be sent to other backends alongside Bento. Its CLI covers dashboard actions (reading runs, signals and analytics) and can emit plain JSON to stdout for piping into files, which is a workable but piecemeal export path. missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all stored traces/runs/issues, explicit data-portability or account-exit docs, an export-format specification, independent corroboration that full history can be extracted.
